name: Intel Xeon 6787P specifications
notes: Intel ARK spec page. 86 cores / 172 threads, 2.0 GHz base, 3.2 GHz all-core turbo, 3.8 GHz max turbo, 336 MB cache, TDP 350 W, 4 UPI at 24 GT/s, 8 memory channels, DDR5-6400 and MRDIMM (page lists maximum speed 8000 MT/s; memory-types line also says MRDIMM 8800), max memory 4 TB, FCLGA4710, scalability 2S, 88 PCIe 5.0 lanes, AMX present, lithography Intel 3, launch Q1'25, RCP $11,648. 8-channel part, not 12.
